title: Tizen OS 10.0
description: delivers a modernized core and developer stack with upgraded kernels, faster IPC, and a new HAL IPC separating platform from product. The toolchain jumps to GCC 14, LLVM 19, and glibc 2.40, while graphics and UI gain Wayland 1.23, Vulkan 1.3.296, and a redesigned Enlightenment for multi-display. Web moves to Chromium 130/Electron 33, multimedia to FFmpeg 7.1 with codec HAL, and AppFW/.NET adds RPK and AI-ready Action Framework. ML API 1.8.8 and NNStreamer 2.4.4 bring async inference and llama.cpp support for next-gen performance and productivity.
